text:
monitoring-bot: [ALERT] ap-northeast2 - region_synthetic_probe - elevated 5xx and tcp resets (5m)

sara_ops: seeing huge 5xx spike, dashboards show control-plane API latency and dropped conn counts

mike_infra: confirmed kube-apiserver in ap-northeast2 unreachable from our peering proxies, multiple nodes report 'network unreachable'

ana_sre: edge gateways show BGP neighbor down across several POPs in ap-northeast2 :warning:

sara_ops: provider status page shows a 'partial network disruption' note but no ETA, last update 12m ago

mike_infra: attempting ssh to bastion, timing out (tcp handshake fails)

ana_sre: can we start the regional failover runbook? this looks like fabric-level outage, not single service

sara_ops: starting controlled traffic shift to ap-southeast1 canary 10% per runbook step 2

sara_ops: running command:
```
./rshift --from=ap-northeast2 --to=ap-southeast1 --canary=10 --timeout=600
```

mike_infra: heads up: ap-southeast1 has constrained GPU inventory today, pushing too much there will throttle batch jobs

ana_sre: we can reclassify batch to best-effort and drain prod GPU pools if needed

devops-bot: routing update: canary created, 10% traffic redirected to ap-southeast1

sara_ops: canary looks stable so far (2m), initial 200s latencies OK, ap-northeast2 errors still climbing on origin

mike_infra: autoscaler failing to provision new nodes in ap-southeast1 — error: "QuotaExceeded: Insufficient accelerators" on GPU SKU

ana_sre: opened ticket with provider, ref INC12345, support assigned to network/fabric team, asking for fabric-level health and BGP neighbor trace

bob_support: posting short update to status page: "Investigating degraded traffic and control-plane reachability in ap-northeast2, initiating controlled failover."

sara_ops: also toggled model-routing: heavy models -> ap-southeast1, lightweight -> eu-west1 to spread load and avoid single-region capacity hit

mike_infra: note: routing change will increase API tokens/cost in fallback regions, finance flagged for postmortem @carol_finance

carol_finance: acknowledged, please capture projected delta in GPU-hours and egress for the incident report

ana_sre: bridge created: https://zoom.internal/incident-2128001234 (join for triage)

sara_ops: tl;dr for now: ap-northeast2 experiencing region-level network fabric disruption; control-plane partially unreachable; we initiated canary traffic shift to ap-southeast1, opened provider ticket, and adjusted model routing to reduce pressure. Next: confirm provider ETA, watch canary health, prepare for larger 100% failover if fabric not recovered :rotating_light:

monitoring-bot: [UPDATE] ap-northeast2 - region_synthetic_probe - 5xx rate now 92% over 5m

mike_infra: per runbook step 3, increasing canary to 40% to reduce immediate customer impact

sara_ops: executed: `./rshift --set-canary=40`

devops-bot: canary update applied (40%)

ana_sre: reminder: this will spike GPU usage in fallback regions and raise spend — keep finance looped

carol_finance: understoood, will compile interim estimate. keep incident channel updated with GPU-hour delta and egress estimates

ana_sre: adding product and support leads to bridge, prepping customer comms draft

sara_ops: will update every 10m or on any major change
